items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: That's Classe Roy. Classe Roy. Played in third sax. Third sax. ... That was a big band.

ctx.x: And this is you. That's me. And the album? That's Classe Roy. Classe Roy. Played in third sax. Third sax.
Classe Roy. Roy. R-O-Y. R-O-Y. And who's the bass player? John Sandis. John Sandis. That was a big band. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
